title: Wikipedia geometry item 17: Section conjecture on splittings of group homomorphisms from fundamental groups of complete smo…
exact_target: For a complete hyperbolic curve over a field finitely generated over the rationals, do its rational points correspond exactly to the splittings of its arithmetic fundamental-group sequence, up to conjugacy by the geometric fundamental group?
